value.value: The 150@ sample is assigned cubic Pm-3m, corner-sharing MnCl6 in three dimensions. Products at 180 and 200 °C are assigned rhombohedral R-3m, with face-sharing Mn3Cl12 motifs linked into a three-dimensional framework. The 1D label describes the chain/polyhedral motif and does not mean an isolated chain-only product.
